description: Number of public electric vehicle charging devices (all) - WMCA is a dataset listed in Birmingham City Observatory open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Department for Transport. This shows the total number of publicly available electric vehicle charging devices. This figure is based on charging devices at all speeds. Coverage: West Midlands Combined Authority area, including Birmingham. The portal files it under Transport. Its keywords are west midlands combined authority, wmca, lgof, local government outcomes framework, ev, electric vehicles. The portal shows 252 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-03 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is OGL-UK-3.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-cityobservatory-birmingham-gov-uk-portal.
